placementRules.notes: Session 48 runtime-style correction of v001. Canvas dimensions, silhouette bounding box, footprint and pivot are BIT-IDENTICAL to v001 (only alpha cleanup and RGB tone/texture were touched, no crop or resize), so the Session 46 measured geometry in EDGE_PROP_DEFS (game.js) carries over unchanged - no placement/road-intrusion values were retuned. minSpacing and placementWeight stay 0 for the same reason as v001: no procedural pool exists, this record must not enter a runtime pool on its own.

notes: PAB-MUMBAI-ENVPROP-VADA-PAV-CART-V1, Session 48 runtime-style correction pilot. Source: v001 binary (mumbai_prop_vadapav_cart_fixed_canopy_right_neutral_1x_v001.png), corrected via a deterministic local pipeline (scipy/opencv/PIL) - no re-generation, no redesign. Alpha: removed the baked ground-contact shadow and 9,534 sub-alpha-8 dust pixels by keeping only alpha>=200 core plus a 4px dilation (real antialiasing fringe), zeroing everything else; measured alpha>=32 bbox is IDENTICAL before/after (226,431)-(949,1056), so EDGE_PROP_DEFS visualBounds/footprint/cropSafe/pivot in game.js needed no changes. Style: cv2.pyrMeanShiftFiltering (sp=18, sr=45) flattened painterly gradients into broader colour regions, followed by a light bilateral pass and PIL contrast x0.78 / saturation x0.75 / brightness x1.06. Measured effect: Laplacian-std texture 61.6->46.0 (-25%), greyscale contrast std 57.8->43.7 (-24%), mean HSV saturation 136->85 (-38%). Honest limit: this is a raster filter pass, not a re-illustration - it cannot add the bold flat cel-shade outline the existing procedural/hand-drawn game props use (see assets/props/mumbai-day.png), so full stylistic parity with those props still requires re-authoring, not further filtering. Session 50: PM reviewed a before/after + honest-gap (vs. native game art) comparison and approved the pipeline as good enough to proceed, on the basis that the whole game's art direction is expected to be revamped later anyway - status flipped to approved, night-palette call resolved (no glow/wash clash). Test B (mixed placement with the chai counter, same right edge) ran clean: both production claims register in the composer with zero overlap, zero console errors day and night, deterministic across reloads. See docs/art-production/PRODUCTION_ASSET_BRIEFS.md and CHANGELOG.md for the Session 48/50 write-ups.
